role: StrapRecordingCoordinator extension: arming the strap's own recording (H10 exercise / Verity offline PPI) with the rescue→clear→begin sequence, clearing/listing stored recordings, reading recording status, and the explicit Discard path.
types: StrapRecordingCoordinator: extension — start/clear/list/status/discard of on-device recordings
toplevel: SDK-dependent members are inside `#if canImport(PolarBleSdk)` blocks; without the SDK startRecording/checkRecordingStatus/stopOfflinePpiRecording/discardStoredExercises throw sdkNotAvailable and clear/check are no-ops.

units.does: Decides via StrapRecordingPolicy.startDecision from api/device/connection/recording state and dispatches: throws notConnected or alreadyRecording, else runs the Verity Sense or H10 start sequence; without the SDK throws sdkNotAvailable.

branches.cond: decision .notConnected (no api, no device id, or not .connected)

units.does: Arms a fresh recording: refuses (CancellationError) when arming is withdrawn; if the strap reports it is already recording (or, when it cannot be asked, the app's flag says so), sets that recording aside via setAsideRunningRecording (H10: download to the rescue backup; Verity: stop only), then runs startRecording.

branches.cond: strap (or fallback app flag) says a recording is running
branches.effect: true → setAsideRunningRecording(), whose errors propagate and abort arming; false → straight to startRecording

units.does: Sets aside the recording the strap is running before arming. Calls beginTransfer. H10 (any non-Verity type): downloads it with fetchRecording(recordedSince: nil, .attended) — which stops it and puts its start on the download record, so the start's own rescue skips it — and hands non-empty points to onUnrecoveredDataRescued. Verity Sense: only stops it (stopWithinBudget) and waits 500 ms for the sensor to list it as complete; the start sequence's rescue step then reads it with every other unsaved recording, so it is filed once.
calls: closure:onUnrecoveredDataRescued — RRCollector.backUpRescuedRecording (RRCollector+Lifecycle.swift:61) writes a RawRRBackup under a new UUID

branches.effect: fetchRecording(recordedSince: nil, .attended) (errors propagate); rescue the points when non-empty; return
true → onUnrecoveredDataRescued(stale); false → nothing backed up

branches.cond: Verity: stop fails or times out
branches.effect: error propagates and aborts arming; otherwise sleep 500 ms and return

units.does: Throws CancellationError (and logs) unless stillWanted() is true, the task is not cancelled, and no transfer is in flight.

branches.effect: true → return; false → log 'Arming withdrawn' and throw CancellationError

units.does: Asks the strap whether it is recording (checkRecordingStatus); on any error logs and falls back to the app's isRecordingOnDevice flag.

branches.cond: checkRecordingStatus throws (not connected, feature not usable, BLE error)
branches.effect: error logged and swallowed; returns manager.isRecordingOnDevice, which after a relaunch is false (comment :42-46), so a running recording is then not rescued before startRecording

units.does: Verity Sense arming: requires offlineRecording usable, sets recordingState .starting, then runs runVeritySenseStartSteps inside settlingAbortedStart, so a step that throws (arming withdrawn, sensor not ready, start refused) returns the state from .starting to .idle before the error propagates.

Runs the Verity StrapStartSequence steps in order, re-checking arming permission before each: rescue (rescueUnrecoveredOfflineRecordings — only recordings the app does not already hold), clear (only when the rescue succeeded), and begin (startOfflinePpiRecording).
writes: ble:Verity Sense offline recordings (deleted by the clear, started by begin)

branches.effect: requireArmingAllowed first; a throw ends the loop and propagates
clearExistingTolerantly('recordings') — deletes every offline PPI recording
skip the clear; the new recording starts beside the undownloaded one

units.does: Runs a start body; if it throws, moves recordingState from .starting back to .idle (any other state is left alone) and rethrows, so an aborted arming never leaves the app refusing later starts as already recording.
calls: closure:start — runVeritySenseStartSteps or the H10 step loop in startH10Recording

units.does: Logs and runs clearAnyExistingExercises; any error is logged as a warning and swallowed so the start continues.

branches.effect: warning logged, error swallowed; for an H10 the subsequent start then fails with error 106 (comment :233)

units.does: Reads the Verity offline PPI recordings the app does not already hold (fetchUnsavedOfflinePpiRecordings, every one required) and passes non-empty results to onUnrecoveredDataRescued; returns true when nothing needs keeping (all saved, none stored, empty, or rescued) and false when a read failed so the caller skips the clear.

branches.cond: catch PolarError.noRecordingFound (nothing stored, or everything stored is already saved)
any other error (fetchFailed for a partial download, BLE error)
branches.effect: log warning, return false — caller leaves recordings on the strap

units.does: H10 arming: requires h10Recording usable, then inside settlingAbortedStart runs each StrapStartSequence step after re-checking arming permission, so a throw after the clear step set .starting returns the state to .idle.

branches.effect: requireArmingAllowed before each; a throw propagates after settlingAbortedStart resets .starting to .idle

units.does: Executes one H10 start step.

branches.effect: rescueUndownloadedH10Recordings() — throws strapHoldsUndownloadedRecording if any unsaved exercise cannot be downloaded

units.does: For every stored H10 exercise the app does not hold, downloads it by id (attended budget) and hands it to onUnrecoveredDataRescued; a failed download aborts arming with strapHoldsUndownloadedRecording.

branches.effect: log external error and throw strapHoldsUndownloadedRecording (original error discarded)

units.does: Lists stored H10 exercises and returns the ids whose start (decoded from the app's exercise id) is not saved per isRecordingSaved; undecodable ids count as unsaved.

branches.cond: decoded start exists and isRecordingSaved(start) == true
branches.effect: drop the id (nil); otherwise (undecodable or not saved) keep it for rescue

units.does: Starts the H10 exercise recording; on failure converts the error through surfaceStartFailure and throws the result.

branches.effect: throw surfaceStartFailure(error) (strapBatteryTooLow or the original error)

units.does: Sends api.startRecording(deviceId, exerciseId: StrapExerciseDecoder.exerciseId() (timestamp id), interval 1s, sampleType .rr) and on success sets recordingState .recording and isRecordingOnDevice true.

branches.effect: throw PolarError.notConnected (then surfaced as a recordingFailed lastError)

units.does: Shared by the H10 and Verity Sense starts: logs the start failure, sets recordingState .idle, and sets lastError: strapBatteryTooLow(percent: last batteryLevel) for a PFTP BATTERY_TOO_LOW refusal (returned to the caller), otherwise recordingFailed(humanized message) while returning the original error.

branches.effect: false → lastError = recordingFailed(humanized), return original error; true → lastError and return value = strapBatteryTooLow(percent:)

units.does: True when the error is BlePsFtpException.responseError whose code maps to Protocol_PbPFtpError.batteryTooLow (209).

branches.effect: false → return false; true → compare code with .batteryTooLow

units.does: Display name of the connected device type for log lines.
Clears stored recordings on the connected strap: Verity → offline PPI recordings, anything else → H10 exercises; no-op when nothing is connected or without the SDK.

branches.effect: true → clearOfflinePpiRecordings; false (H10 or nil type) → clearStoredExercises

units.does: Verity: removes every offline PPI recording, logging how many were removed. Throws notConnected without an API/device id and featureNotReady when the offline-recording feature is not usable, so a caller never treats an unattempted clear as done.

branches.effect: requireUsable throws featureNotReady — nothing cleared, the caller sees the error
log 'No offline PPI recordings to clear' and return; else log count

units.does: H10: lists stored exercises and removes each one via api.removeExercise, logging; errors propagate.

branches.effect: removeExercise; first failure throws and leaves the rest

units.does: Lists the Verity's offline PPI recordings off the main actor: collects api.listOfflineRecordings into an array, keeps only .ppi entries and dedups to one entry per recording path via StrapOfflineRecordingEntries.onePerRecording. The single listing used by the stored-recordings check, removal and the offline reads.

branches.cond: for each entry yielded by the stream

units.does: Lists PPI entries and removes each with api.removeOfflineRecord; returns how many were removed.
Collects api.listExercises(deviceId) into an array of PolarExerciseEntry.

Asks the strap whether it is recording (Verity: offline-recording status for PPI; H10: requestRecordingStatus), applies the answer to isRecordingOnDevice/recordingState via applyStatus, and returns it.

branches.cond: strapAPI nil or no device id

branches.effect: true → veritySenseRecordingStatus; false → H10 status + applyStatus

units.does: Verity: requires offlineRecording usable, reads getOfflineRecordingStatus, treats a missing .ppi key as false, applies it and returns it.

Applies StrapRecordingPolicy.statusOutcome: sets isRecordingOnDevice and moves recordingState only when the outcome names a state (.recording when ongoing; .idle when not ongoing and current was .recording).

branches.effect: assign it; nil (transitional states starting/stopping/fetching, or idle) → leave recordingState unchanged

units.does: Refreshes hasStoredExercise/storedExerciseDate from the strap: Verity via offline recordings, H10 via stored exercises; logs and returns when no device id.

branches.cond: strapAPI nil or no device id

units.does: Verity: if offlineRecording usable, lists PPI recordings (listPpiEntries) and sets hasStoredExercise = non-empty and storedExerciseDate = earliest entry date; on a listing error logs and keeps the last known values.

branches.effect: log and return; flags left unchanged
log; hasStoredExercise and storedExerciseDate keep their last values (an error is not read as an empty strap)

units.does: H10: lists stored exercises, finds the newest by app exercise id and decodes its start date; sets hasStoredExercise = non-empty and storedExerciseDate = that start (nil when undecodable); on a listing error logs and keeps the last known values.

branches.effect: logs 'unknown'; storedExerciseDate nil so RRCollector.hasUnrecoveredData is false for a foreign/undecodable exercise
log; hasStoredExercise and storedExerciseDate keep their last values

units.does: Verity: requires a connection and offlineRecording usable, stops the PPI offline recording, sets isRecordingOnDevice false and recordingState .idle.
Returns api.requestRecordingStatus(deviceId) (ongoing flag + entry id).

User 'Discard & Start Fresh': requires a connection, stops a recording the strap reports as running (bounded; stopBeforeDiscarding asks the strap rather than trusting the app's flag), deletes every stored recording via clearAnyExistingExercises, then sets hasStoredExercise false and storedExerciseDate nil. Any throw (stop timeout, Verity feature not ready, removal error) propagates before the flags are reset, so the screen never shows a discard that did not happen.

branches.effect: error propagates to RecordView (sessionState.lastError); hasStoredExercise/storedExerciseDate untouched

units.does: Asks the strap whether it is recording (deviceIsRecording, falling back to the app's flag when the strap cannot be asked) and, if so, stops it within the attended budget (stopWithinBudget) before Discard clears it.

branches.cond: strap (or fallback flag) says nothing is recording

units.does: Runs stopOnStrap under StrapDeadline with the attended stop budget, timing out with fetchFailed('strap stop timed out after Ns'), so a stale link cannot hang Discard or the Verity arming's set-aside.
Stops the running recording: Verity via stopOfflinePpiRecording, H10 via stopH10Recording(awaitFinalize: true, no progress, not cancellable, streamHoldsIt false).
